intentional_exclusions: Unrelated blog posts and repositories; generated/dependency bundles.
Whole media/model/font libraries and their replay machinery.
Archived agent instructions; never imported as active plugin instructions.

open_limits: Current demo captures are not runtime verified; the bubble HTML is an application error.
The capture report records historical script 404s, missing binary URLs, and page-body gaps.
Third-party papers and media linked in articles are indexed as references; their complete payloads are not all bundled.
Captured source does not establish current API compatibility or mathematical correctness.
